text: dsh-ocr1-memory 是一款面向 DSH Agent 的记忆插件，通过工具接口接收、更新和检索记忆，并将文本分段渲染为带 SoM 编号的图像保存。它按记忆年龄调整图像分辨率，检索命中旧记忆时可触发主动回忆恢复高清内容；还提供文本与光学检索、三层记忆治理、上下文注入和自动维护。适合需要长期保存 Agent 事实与操作流程、并在后续会话中查找原文的场景。使用 OCR 需配置兼容接口；也可配置本机 llama-server，API key 按服务需要提供。

dsh-ocr1-memory adds memory tools to DSH agents. It renders text as SoM-marked images, lowers resolution as memories age, and restores detail when retrieved. Tools support storage, OCR search, updates, and governance. OCR search needs a compatible endpoint; local hosting is optional.

dsh-ocr1-memory 的功能「光学记忆存取」：把输入文本分段并渲染成带 SoM 编号的图像保存。调用 ocr1_mem_store 写入，之后可通过检索按片段找回原始文本。
dsh-ocr1-memory 的功能「分辨率衰减与主动回忆」：记忆按年龄使用 vivid、normal、fuzzy 分辨率层级；检索命中低清记忆时可恢复高清表示。用户通过 ocr1_mem_retrieve 查询并取得片段。
dsh-ocr1-memory 的功能「分层治理记忆」：提供记忆读取、写入、检索、确认候选、更新、归档和回滚等工具，可将带 evidence 的 fact 或 SOP 纳入长期治理。Agent 通过对应 memory_* 工具调用。
dsh-ocr1-memory 的功能「失败重试候选记录」：观察同一工具调用失败后成功的序列，并在回合结束时形成待审阅的记忆候选。自动化在工具结果和会话事件中触发，无需单独命令。
dsh-ocr1-memory 使用 OCR 需配置服务地址；若启用本机托管服务，还需提供 llama-server 和对应模型文件路径，默认自动启动关闭。

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · 核心设计与技术亮点：* **文本光学压缩（Optical Context Compression）**：打破传统纯文本或嵌入向量存储的局限，将段落文本渲染为密集视觉图像。通过视觉 Token 替代海量文本 Token，在长程上下文中显著削减 Token 开销。
* **分级分辨率衰减与主动回忆（Active Recall）**：
  * **时间衰减三档位**：记忆图像随时间推移在 `vivid (高清)` → `normal (标准)` → `fuzzy (模糊/低显存)` 档位间动态退化。
  * **主动回忆机制**：当检索命中低分辨率历史记忆时，系统触发 Active Recall 将其自动恢复至高清层，保证后续重读的高置信度。
* **SoM 空间标记与光学定位器（Optical Locator）**：
  * 图像预置 SoM 编号锚点，支持可选的轻量级本地视觉定位器（基于 GGUF/llama-server）。
  * 模型仅需输出 K-bit 的 `0/1` 视觉分类标记即可快速命中目标候选段落，最后精准还原并输出百分之百真实的原文。
* **压缩效率监控面板（Metrics & Baseline）**：内建 `ocr1_mem_metrics` 工具，实时跟踪文本 Token 数、视觉 Token 消耗及实际光学压缩比。
* **完备的治理与生命周期**：原生兼容三层记忆治理体系（L1 索引紧凑化、版本回滚、归档与跨命名空间晋升）。

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · 运行架构：```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["原始长文本"] --> B["段落切片与排版引擎"]
    B --> C["渲染为 SoM 空间标记图像"]
    C --> D["三档分辨率衰减管理 (vivid / normal / fuzzy)"]

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · 工具矩阵：| 工具名称 | 核心职责 | 技术特征 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ocr1_mem_store` | 将文本切片、渲染为 SoM 图像并光学存盘 | 光学渲染与索引录入 |
| `ocr1_mem_retrieve` | 光学与文本混合检索，触发 Active Recall | 多模态召回与高清恢复 |
| `ocr1_mem_metrics` | 统计文本 Token、视觉 Token 及压缩比率 | 量化评估面板 |
| `ocr1_mem_update` | 更新记忆内容并重置其生命周期活跃度 | 增量重构与刷新 |
| `ocr1_mem_calibrate`| 校准基准分词器与文本 Token 估算基线 | 基线标定 |
| `ocr1_mem_forget` | 彻底擦除指定记忆及其衍生的光学图像文件 | 物理擦除 |
| `memory_read` / `write` | 兼容通用分层治理读写接口 | 治理体系互通 |

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · @dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory：**Optical memory extension for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) based on DeepSeek-OCR Contexts Optical Compression (OCR1).**

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · @dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory：Implements the cutting-edge "Contexts Optical Compression" (OCR1) architecture from the DeepSeek-OCR research paper into practical agent engineering. Text memories are partitioned into coherent paragraphs, formatted, and rendered as visual images tagged with Set-of-Mark (SoM) indicators. By encoding verbose context into compact visual tokens, it achieves dramatic context reduction alongside dynamic decay and active recall mechanisms that guarantee lossless verbatim retrieval.

---

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · Architectural Highlights：* **Optical Context Compression**: Transcends standard text buffers and vector databases by rendering memory paragraphs into dense visual layouts. Leverages multimodal visual tokens to encapsulate long-horizon history at vastly lower token footprints.
* **Resolution Tier Decay & Active Recall**:
  * **Three Progressive Decay Tiers**: Historical memory images gracefully degrade across `vivid (full res)` → `normal (standard)` → `fuzzy (low footprint)` based on access age.
  * **Active Recall Restoration**: Query hits on decayed entries automatically trigger Active Recall, restoring the asset to high-resolution before subsequent inspection.
* **SoM Labeling & Optical Locator**:
  * Employs numbered visual bounding markers compatible with an optional on-device optical locator (powered by GGUF/llama-server).
  * The model outputs concise K-bit `0/1` visual classifications to filter candidate segments, culminating in zero-loss verbatim text retrieval.
* **Real-Time Efficiency Metrics**: Includes the `ocr1_mem_metrics` tool to benchmark raw text tokens against visual tokens, reporting actual optical compression multipliers.
*

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · Processing Flow：```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Verbatim Source Text"] --> B["Partitioning & Layout Engine"]
    B --> C["Render to SoM-Annotated Images"]
    C --> D["Resolution Tier Decay (vivid / normal / fuzzy)"]

@dsh-external/dsh-ocr1-memory README · Tool Overview：| Tool Name | Core Role | Implementation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ocr1_mem_store` | Partitions, renders SoM images, and registers optical memory | Rendering & indexing pipeline |
| `ocr1_mem_retrieve` | Hybrid optical/text retrieval with Active Recall restoration | Optical recall engine |
| `ocr1_mem_metrics` | Measures text tokens, visual tokens, and compression ratios | Evaluation telemetry |
| `ocr1_mem_update` | Rewrites memory content and resets decay aging | Incremental re-rendering |
| `ocr1_mem_calibrate`| Calibrates tokenizer baseline for accurate compression ratios | Baseline benchmarking |
| `ocr1_mem_forget` | Erases specified memory entries and on-disk visual assets | Complete asset purge |
| `memory_read` / `write` | Unified governance endpoints across layered memory systems | Governance parity |
